video_title: Ball Brothers React to Knicks Championship + Spurs Collapse - BITF Ep. 24

quotes.speaker: Zo
quotes.summary_phrase: Lonzo Ball on Victor Wembanyama's rookie season and Spurs' progress
quotes.excerpt: He just got to get better. That's all that is. I think he had a great year.
quotes.quote: No stain. He just got to get better. That's all that is. I think he had a great year. I think the Spurs had a tremendous year.

quotes.speaker: Zo
quotes.summary_phrase: Lonzo Ball on the Spurs' roster decisions regarding De'Aaron Fox
quotes.excerpt: You have to move them in that heart-break loss. I'd investigate De'Aaron Fox.
quotes.quote: You have to move them in that heart-break loss. I'd investigate De'Aaron Fox.

quotes.speaker: Zo
quotes.summary_phrase: Lonzo Ball's proposed lineup strategy for the Spurs
quotes.excerpt: I'm switching. I'm running them three, Vassel, Vassel, I don't know, and I'm running Wembanyama.
quotes.quote: I'm switching. I'm running them three, Vassel, Vassel, I don't know, and I'm running Wembanyama. I'm switching everything, keeping Wembanyama low, and running it like that.

quotes.speaker: Zo
quotes.summary_phrase: Lonzo Ball on Victor Wembanyama's need for a go-to move
quotes.excerpt: He needs to learn how to do a jump hook for one. I don't know why.
quotes.quote: He needs to learn how to do a jump hook for one. I don't know why he doesn't shoot any jump hooks. He got great touch. I don't know why he don't just get on the high post, though. He really needs to go to the high post.

quotes.speaker: Zo
quotes.summary_phrase: Lonzo Ball on Jalen Brunson's standing among players under six feet
quotes.excerpt: Where does he rank for best players under six feet? He better than Isaiah Thomas.
quotes.quote: Where does he rank for best players under six feet? He better than Isaiah Thomas.

quotes.speaker: Zo
quotes.summary_phrase: Lonzo Ball on the Spurs' defensive confusion in the playoffs
quotes.excerpt: The Spurs came out and they didn't even know who they was guarding. Wembanyama switched like three times.
quotes.quote: The Spurs came out and they didn't even know who they was guarding. Wembanyama switched like three times. I was like, bro, what are you doing? That type of confusing is why you lose games.

quotes.speaker: Zo
quotes.summary_phrase: Lonzo Ball on why the Knicks are effective closers
quotes.excerpt: One, Jalen Brunson. Two, the fans. Once New York gets going, especially at home, I've seen it.
quotes.quote: One, Jalen Brunson. Two, the fans. Once New York gets going, especially at home, I've seen it. I've seen it on Christmas.

quotes.speaker: Zo
quotes.summary_phrase: Lonzo Ball on Jalen Brunson's legacy compared to Kawhi Leonard
quotes.excerpt: He's not better than those. He's not better than Kawhi.
quotes.quote: He's not better than those. He's not better than Kawhi.

quotes.speaker: Zo
quotes.summary_phrase: Lonzo Ball on Jalen Brunson's career path
quotes.excerpt: If you ask me if I can take Brunson's route, I think he ended up choosing the right.
quotes.quote: If you ask me if I can take Brunson's route, I think he ended up choosing the right route, for sure.

quotes.speaker: Zo
quotes.summary_phrase: Lonzo Ball on the Knicks' championship chances next season
quotes.excerpt: The Knicks got a better chance to get them back than the Spurs probably do.
quotes.quote: The Knicks got a better chance to get them back than the Spurs probably do.

quotes.speaker: Zo
quotes.summary_phrase: Lonzo Ball on the hypothetical 10-week sex ban for a championship
quotes.excerpt: Guaranteed ring. If it's not guaranteed, then I'll just find my own way.
quotes.quote: Guaranteed ring. If it's not guaranteed, then I'll just find my own way.

quotes.speaker: Zo
quotes.summary_phrase: Lonzo Ball on his lack of personal fandom for specific teams
quotes.excerpt: I don't think that's why I'm not like a real fan, though. I like players more.
quotes.quote: I don't think that's why I'm not like a real fan, though. I like players more.

quotes.speaker: Zo
quotes.summary_phrase: Lonzo Ball on his appreciation for Lamar Jackson and Derrick Henry
quotes.excerpt: I'm happy for Lamar Jackson, Derrick Henry, but I'm not crying and shit like, oh my god.
quotes.quote: I'm happy for Lamar Jackson, Derrick Henry, but I'm not crying and shit like, oh my god, the fucking Ravens did it.

quotes.speaker: Zo
quotes.summary_phrase: Lonzo Ball on the popularity of football versus basketball
quotes.excerpt: I'd say this, there's more die-hard fans in football than basketball, I think.
quotes.quote: I'd say this, there's more die-hard fans in football than basketball, I think. And the stadiums are bigger in football, too.

quotes.speaker: Zo
quotes.summary_phrase: Lonzo Ball on the Knicks' playoff run

quotes.quote: The drought is over, man. New York, y'all go crazy, you know what I'm saying? Now it's on to the best.

quotes.speaker: Zo
quotes.summary_phrase: Lonzo Ball on his choice of players who never won a ring

quotes.quote: I believe Saint Laurent. Yeah, Saint Laurent, YSL, how you say that? I don't know. I got it, though.

quotes.excerpt: We'll do basketball for these two, we'll do football for you.

quotes.speaker: Zo
quotes.summary_phrase: Lonzo Ball on the dynamics of attraction in relationships
quotes.excerpt: If there is an unattractive person and they're with another unattractive person, do they both know?
quotes.quote: If there is an unattractive person and they're with another unattractive person, do they both know that they're unattractive, or do you think they both think that they're attractive?

quotes.speaker: Zo
quotes.summary_phrase: Lonzo Ball on the importance of shared experiences in relationships
quotes.excerpt: I think a relationship is built off a bunch of different shit for it to keep going.
quotes.quote: I think a relationship is built off a bunch of different shit for it to keep going. So, for me, I have to be attracted to you, but some people can might be able to bypass that if they check off every other box.
